fare_dispute.headline: Formal Appeal: Contested Fare Discrepancy and Account Reinstatement
fare_dispute.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am writing to formally contest the fare adjustment or account restriction regarding trip {trip_id} on {date} at {time} along {location} (disputed fare: {money}). The recorded adjustment does not reflect the actual distance, duration, and M-Pesa payment records.

Pursuant to NTSA Legal Notice 120 of 2022 Regulation 13(1)(b) (POL-NTSA-13) on fare transparency and Regulation 15(1) (POL-NTSA-15) on fair administrative action, as well as platform fare review terms and TAWU Grievance Protocol Clause 4 (POL-TAWU-01), I request a review of the attached trip receipt and M-Pesa statement, reconciliation of the fare, and full account restoration.

passenger_safety.headline: Formal Appeal: Response to Safety Incident Allegation
passenger_safety.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am submitting this formal response regarding the safety report logged on {date} at {time} near {location} (trip {trip_id}). I maintain a clean safety record, followed platform safety protocols throughout the journey, and dispute the allegation.

In accordance with NTSA Legal Notice 120 of 2022 Regulation 15(1) (POL-NTSA-15) guaranteeing a driver's right to be heard prior to deactivation, Regulation 18(1)-(2) (POL-NTSA-18) on incident reporting, and TAWU Grievance Protocol Clause 4 (POL-TAWU-01), please review the attached incident timestamp log, official police abstract/documentation, and supporting evidence to lift this suspension.

rating_or_cancellation.headline: Formal Appeal: Review of Unfair Rating and Cancellation Flag
rating_or_cancellation.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am requesting a formal review of the account restriction resulting from disputed ratings or trip cancellations on {date} at {time} in {location} (trip {trip_id}). These events were caused by inaccurate pickup pins, passenger-requested cancellations, or factors outside driver control.

Under NTSA Legal Notice 120 of 2022 Regulation 15(1) (POL-NTSA-15) on due process before suspension, Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 Sections 26 & 35 (POL-DPA-26) on human review of automated penalties, and TAWU Grievance Protocol Clause 4 (POL-TAWU-01), I ask that you review my attached in-app chat logs, rating history, and counter-statement and reinstate my account.

fraud_flag.headline: Formal Appeal: Request for Human Review of Algorithmic Fraud Flag
fraud_flag.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am writing to appeal the automated fraud flag placed on my account on {date} regarding trip activity near {location} (trip {trip_id}, amount {money}). I have not engaged in GPS manipulation, account sharing, or fraudulent trips; any telemetry anomalies were due to network/GPS drift.

Pursuant to Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 Sections 26 & 35 (POL-DPA-26) granting the right to human review of solely automated decisions, NTSA Legal Notice 120 of 2022 Regulation 15(1) (POL-NTSA-15) on fair administrative action, and TAWU Grievance Protocol Clause 4 (POL-TAWU-01), please review my attached chronological trip log, location history, and M-Pesa receipts and reactivate my account.
